decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-204 MODIFY establishing proportional Hero V derivation, proportional terminal transfer, and removal of the obsolete fixed terminal treatment.

The existing message-204 MODIFY already records the Hero V terminal exploration, preserved geometry, endpoint elevation, and terminal constraints; the accent derivation change requires no additional Hero V update.
The existing message-204 MODIFY fully captures that only the Hero V terminal may vary and that the selected treatment must later transfer directly to the accent and proportionally to the second V.
Message 204 reaffirms the already-current exact peak-alignment rule without changing its value or reference.
The second V remains a restrained proportional echo above the alphabet under its existing hierarchy state; the accent derivation update does not change that hierarchy.
The candidate already has a complete message-204 MODIFY covering the paired two-column format, six terminal treatments, reference guides, and single-variable comparison constraint.
The literal transfer of selected Hero V terminal geometry to the É accent does not alter the E and L construction, proportions, scale, or architectural language.
The É accent remains one of the selected champagne-gold elements regardless of its revised terminal derivation; the color distribution is unchanged.
Changing how the É accent inherits terminal geometry does not change the selected Balanced Flow kerning or the wordmark's spacing objective.
The selected Satin Reflection finish and its material characteristics remain valid independently of the accent's terminal derivation.
The source decision concerns terminal derivation and peak correspondence, not the shared lower baseline of the wordmark.
The all-caps case treatment remains unchanged and is semantically independent of the É accent's literal Hero V terminal derivation.
